context: Sakura sends Asuka a letter with her new book.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、手紙、ありがとう。
lines.en: Sakura-san, thank you for the letter.
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Genuine gratitude in the voice — not performed. Slight pause after her name, tender and present. Soft throughout, like holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、本も、一緒に、送りました。
lines.en: I sent the book along with it, sensei.
lines.style: Quiet, respectful. A little shy about the generosity of the gesture. Even pace, warm undertone. The voice of someone who trusts the person she's speaking to.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大切に、読みます、本当に。
lines.en: I'll read it carefully — I really will.
lines.style: Emphasis soft on 「大切に」 — the promise is in the care, not the volume. Slow, deliberate. Eyes steady. A vow wrapped in gentleness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I've felt your gratitude this whole time — truly.
lines.style: Voice tight with emotion held close. Not shaky, but full. Slow delivery. The words matter more than breath. A moment of honesty between two people.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: お前の言葉、繋がってる、いつも。
lines.en: Your words have always been there, connecting us.
lines.style: Philosophical, warm. Not distant — intimate in the way wisdom can be. Slight breathiness on 「繋がってる」. The voice of someone who sees what matters most.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、宝。
lines.en: Coming here with you — that's been my treasure.
lines.style: Voice opens slightly on this — vulnerability and strength at once. Medium pace, steady. The word 「宝」 lands with quiet weight. Real emotion, no shield.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I'll write back to you again — I promise.
lines.style: Soft closing warmth. A gentle commitment, not a duty. Slight smile in the voice. Slow, present. The last word 「ね」 a tender agreement between them both.
